title: Provably Secure Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Pengcheng Zhou; Yinglun Feng; Zhongliang Yang
why_relevant: Proposes encryption-based defense for RAG against data leakage and poisoning, tangentially related to adversarial corruption.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is cryptographic confidentiality/integrity rather than robustness to noisy/conflicting evidence; defense via encryption is orthogonal to typical RAG robustness approaches.
